fatal_errors: The material is not identified as the MgAlTiVFeCo alloy.
The SPS intervention and optimal sintering temperature of 1000 °C are omitted.
No structural, oxidation, corrosion, or passivation mechanism is proposed.
No quantitative performance outcomes, baseline comparisons, or operating boundaries are provided.
No evidence or falsifiable experiment supports the claim.
explanation: The hypothesis only restates the desired goal of a lightweight material with superior comprehensive performance. It does not reconstruct the target alloy, processing conditions, oxide barrier phases, diffusion-controlled oxidation and corrosion mechanisms, or measured density, hardness, oxidation, and electrochemical outcomes. With all substantive fields unknown and no cited evidence or discriminating test, it is unsupported.
